Observed red on the real path before the fix, green after. No seam/schema/doc change; no LastGoodValue framework, no gap-specific file or ledger added.

criteria.criterion: AC1 — controlled time + real termination/recovery cover observed cancel/failure, missing end, crash recovery, later success; check the independent interval subtotal, unknown and reliable zero
criteria.evidence: tests/model-cost/pi-runtime-gaps.test.ts (7 pass): cancelled activity (pi `stopReason: aborted` + `agent_settled{aborted:true}`) and terminally failed activity each settle their own interval (45s+30s=75s, hand-derived instants), the interrupted request's own usage commits with it (amount 0.0085 by hand); an activity with no end adds nothing and the file stays byte-identical; a reopened instance reads back 45s (not the wall-clock span, not unknown) and a late settle ends nothing; a later successful activity adds 20s while the mark stays; real host: tests/harness-dock/model-cost-runtime-gap.test.ts (1 pass) — real OMP 18.5.0 measures a positive child runtimeMs (no gap), a process killed mid-activity leaves consumption.json byte-identical, and a third process resumes the session and commits its own new child figure while the first child's record stays field-identical.

criteria.criterion: AC2 — read the saved value and the new process's display, confirm the gap is retained with the period; actual clear/holiday start a fresh accumulation and late old-period activity does not backfill
criteria.evidence: pi suite: a second binding over the same storage root reads the figure+mark and continues (50 000 → 70 000 with the mark); `/budget clear` archives the closed document (whose record still carries 45 000 + runtimeGap) and the new period answers 'unknown' for that session; the end of the activity left open across the reset writes nothing and marks no gap; a genuinely new activity saves version 1 with runtimeMs 15 000 and no mark; first `/budget holiday` behaves the same with holiday=true; seeded old document shows value/legal zero/absent kept apart in reads, display rows and the frontend's own `Run:` lines (8m / 0ms / —).

criteria.criterion: AC3 — keep ticket 11's verified old-record compatibility, do not turn a precision change into a historical gap, do not add a generic LastGoodValue framework
criteria.evidence: Old document written independently then read/updated/restored at the pi seam (value, legal zero, no value, value+mark): nothing gains a mark from a precision change, the seeded mark survives a later measurement, no file besides consumption.json + the archive appears (rootFiles assertion). ticket 11's own subagent-runtime.test.ts is re-run green inside the partition. No LastGoodValue-style framework exists: reviewed — the mark is one optional boolean on the session's record read leniently (consumption-document.ts) plus one field in SubagentRuntimes.

criteria.criterion: AC4 — P26 complete coverage at S1/S2/S3
criteria.evidence: S1: public pi native facts (run-cycle edges incl. abort, lineage link) through the real pi adapter into the real accounting; S2: the loaded extension's operation interface — the read-only view/presentation rows, the frontend's own drawn `Run:` lines, and operator feedback (the error notice, now naming the failed fact); S3: the document the extension really wrote, a second binding over it, and the real-host dock file. Injection table: 6 targeted mutations each produced failures (A gap cleared by success → 2 cases; B closedActivities guard removed → 1; C absent read as zero → 1; D mark not persisted → 4; E period switch keeps ledgers → 2; G commit gated on consumption only → 7), each restored and re-run green.
